name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with Formula 1, fueled by countless hours spent watching races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Belgrade, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduation, he interned at a local racing team before landing a junior engineer role at Iron Lynx three years ago. 

Nikola's meticulous approach to data analysis and setup adjustments has quickly made him a valuable asset to the team. He's known for his relentless pursuit of performance gains, often pushing drivers to their limits in search of the optimal lap time. He believes in a data-driven approach, but understands the critical importance of driver feedback in the pursuit of success. He is now ready to take on new challenges and climb up the career ladder.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Nikola is of average height, with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and track notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having his workstation perfectly organized before starting any task.
